items.question: Please confirm whether an independent SOC 2 attestation exists and which trust criteria it covers.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane holds a SOC 2 Type II report covering the Security, Availability, and Confidentiality criteria. The latest audit period ended 2026-06-30 and the report is shared under NDA.

items.question: Is your information security program certified under ISO 27001, and which version?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane is certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022. The certificate covers the Corvane Insight platform and corporate IT and is valid until 2028-03-31.

items.question: Is the platform suitable for HIPAA protected health information, and will you sign a business associate agreement?
items.gold_answer: Partial. Corvane signs a Business Associate Agreement for customers on the Enterprise plan only. HIPAA workloads must run in the US region.

items.question: May we load payment card data into the service, and is it covered by PCI DSS?
gold_facts: not in scope for PCI DSS
items.gold_answer: No. Corvane Insight is not in scope for PCI DSS and customers must not upload cardholder data. Payments to Corvane are handled by a PCI DSS Level 1 payment subprocessor.

items.question: How frequently does an outside firm run a penetration test against the application?
items.gold_answer: Yes. An independent firm performs a penetration test of the platform every 6 months. An executive summary of the latest test is available under NDA.

items.question: Will you permit our auditors to perform an on-site audit of your controls?
items.gold_answer: Partial. Customers may review our SOC 2 report and send one security questionnaire per year. On-site audits are available to Enterprise customers with 30 days notice.

items.question: Is federated single sign-on through our identity provider available?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane Insight supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect single sign-on with any compliant identity provider.

items.question: How are user provisioning changes synced from our directory into your product?
items.gold_answer: Yes. User provisioning and deprovisioning are supported through SCIM 2.0 on the Business and Enterprise plans.

items.question: How granular are the role-based permissions for different kinds of users?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The platform provides role-based access control with 5 built-in roles, and custom roles are available on the Enterprise plan.

items.question: How frequently are production access rights reviewed, and how fast is access revoked at termination?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Access to production systems is reviewed every 90 days by system owners, and access is revoked within 24 hours of termination.

items.question: Explain the password rules for accounts that do not use single sign-on.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Local passwords must be at least 12 characters, are checked against a breached password list, and the account locks after 10 failed attempts.

items.question: Explain the approval process before engineers can access production environments.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Engineers have no standing production access. Access is granted just in time for up to 4 hours, requires a ticket and peer approval, and every session is recorded.

items.question: Under what conditions can your support staff access our workspace?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane support staff can open a customer workspace only after the customer grants time-limited access from the admin console, and every action is written to the customer audit log.

items.question: After how long does an inactive session expire?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Web sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity by default, and administrators can set a value between 5 and 480 minutes.

items.question: Is it possible to restrict sign-ins to our office IP ranges?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Enterprise administrators can restrict workspace access to a list of up to 50 IP ranges.

items.question: What TLS protocol versions protect data moving between our users and your service?
items.gold_answer: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher, and TLS 1.3 is preferred. Older protocols are disabled.

items.question: Describe the management and rotation of the encryption keys that protect our data.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Encryption keys are managed in a cloud key management service backed by FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware security modules and are rotated every 12 months.

items.question: Can we control the encryption keys that protect our stored data with our own keys?
items.gold_answer: Partial. Customer managed keys (BYOK) are available on the Enterprise plan for data at rest in the US and EU regions. Hold your own key is not supported.

items.question: Describe your data deletion timeline once our contract terminates.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Customer data is deleted within 30 days after contract termination, and deletion from backups completes within a further 35 days.

items.question: For what period are security and audit logs kept?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Security and audit logs are retained for 13 months, with the most recent 90 days searchable online.

items.question: If we leave, how do we export a complete copy of our data?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Administrators can export all workspace data at any time in CSV or Parquet format through the console or the export API.

items.question: In which hosting regions can our data be stored?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Customers choose one of 3 hosting regions at signup: US (Virginia), EU (Frankfurt), or UK (London). Customer data stays in the selected region.

items.question: How are requests from individuals to delete their personal records fulfilled?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Individual records can be deleted on request through the API, and data subject requests are completed within 30 days.

items.question: What classification level applies internally to customer data we upload?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane classifies information as Public, Internal, Confidential, or Restricted. All customer data is classified as Restricted.

items.question: Will anything we upload be used to train machine learning models?
gold_facts: does not use customer data to train
items.gold_answer: No. Corvane does not use customer data to train machine learning models, and no customer data is sent to a third-party model provider unless the customer enables the AI assistant.

items.question: Describe the hosting environment and data centers for the production service.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane Insight runs on a major public cloud provider across multiple availability zones in each region. Corvane does not operate its own data centers.

items.question: What prevents another tenant from seeing our records in a multi-tenant environment?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The platform is multi-tenant. Each customer workspace is isolated by a tenant id enforced in the data access layer and has a separate encryption key per tenant.

items.question: Can we get a dedicated single-tenant instance or an on-premises install?
items.gold_answer: Partial. A dedicated single-tenant deployment is available on the Enterprise plan for an additional fee. On-premises deployment is not offered.

items.question: Which network controls, such as a firewall, protect the production servers?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Production runs in private subnets with no public IP addresses. Only load balancers are internet-facing, and a web application firewall filters all inbound traffic.

items.question: How is the service protected if an attacker floods it with a denial of service attack?
items.gold_answer: Yes. DDoS protection is provided at the network edge by the cloud provider and the content delivery network, with rate limiting at the API gateway.

items.question: How do you keep server operating systems hardened and patched?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Hosts run a hardened minimal Linux image built from CIS benchmarks and are replaced, not patched in place, at least every 30 days.

items.question: Describe the frequency, location, and retention of your data backups.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Customer data is backed up every 4 hours. Backups are encrypted, stored in a second region, and retained for 35 days.

items.question: What recovery point and recovery time objectives apply if a whole region fails?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The recovery point objective is 4 hours and the recovery time objective is 8 hours for a full region failure.

items.question: Is the disaster recovery plan exercised in practice, and when was it last tested?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The disaster recovery plan is tested every 12 months with a full regional failover exercise. The last test was completed on 2026-04-14.

items.question: What business continuity arrangements keep the company operating through a major disruption?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane maintains a business continuity plan, reviewed every 12 months, that covers loss of offices, key staff, and critical vendors.

items.question: What availability did customers actually experience over the last year?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Measured availability over the last 12 months was 99.97%. Historical uptime is published on the public status page.

items.question: If our data is affected by a security breach, how soon will you notify us?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane notifies affected customers of a confirmed security breach involving their data within 48 hours.

items.question: Has customer data ever been exposed in a security breach of your systems?
items.gold_answer: No. Corvane has not had a security breach involving customer data in the last 5 years.

items.question: Who would carry out forensic investigation of a serious incident, and how is evidence preserved?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane keeps an external incident response firm on retainer and preserves forensic evidence for at least 12 months after an incident.

items.question: How do you scan your software and infrastructure for known vulnerabilities?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Infrastructure and container images are scanned for vulnerabilities daily, and application dependencies are scanned on every build.

items.question: Once a critical vulnerability is found, how long until it is remediated?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Critical vulnerabilities are remediated within 7 days, high within 30 days, and medium within 90 days.

items.question: Is there a way for outside researchers to report vulnerabilities, such as a bug bounty?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane runs a public vulnerability disclosure program and a private bug bounty program managed by an external platform.

items.question: How do you protect employee laptops and uploaded files against malware?
items.gold_answer: Yes. All employee laptops run endpoint detection and response software, and files uploaded to the platform are scanned for malware.

items.question: Who monitors security events in your environment, and at what hours?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Security events are monitored 24 hours a day by an internal security operations team using a SIEM with automated alerting.

items.question: Which subprocessors handle our data, and how are new ones communicated?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane uses 9 subprocessors. The current list is published on the trust center, and customers are notified 30 days before a new subprocessor is added.

items.question: How do you assess the security of the vendors who handle our data?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Vendors with access to customer data are assessed before onboarding and reviewed every 12 months, including a review of their SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report.

items.question: In which countries are staff located who might access our data?
items.gold_answer: Partial. Customer data is stored only in the selected region. Support staff in the US, UK, and Portugal may access data with customer permission.

items.question: What uptime commitment is in the contract, and what service credits apply if it is missed?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane commits to 99.9% monthly uptime for the Business plan and 99.95% for the Enterprise plan, with service credits of up to 25% of monthly fees.

items.question: When is your support team available?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Standard support is available 9am to 6pm on business days. Enterprise customers get 24x7 support for Severity 1 issues.

items.question: If production is down for us, how fast will support respond to a Severity 1 issue?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Severity 1 issues receive a response within 1 hour for Enterprise customers and within 4 hours for Business customers.

items.question: How much notice do we get before planned maintenance?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Planned maintenance is announced at least 5 business days in advance and is scheduled on Sundays between 02:00 and 06:00 UTC. Most releases need no downtime.

items.question: Can our engineers automate the platform through an API, and how is it authenticated?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane Insight provides a REST API documented with OpenAPI 3.1, authenticated with scoped API keys or OAuth 2.0 client credentials.

items.question: What request limits apply to the API?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace on the Business plan and 3,000 requests per minute on the Enterprise plan.

items.question: Which data sources can we connect through connectors?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Native connectors are available for 40 data sources, including cloud data warehouses, object storage, and relational databases.

items.question: Can field staff use the product from a mobile phone app?
gold_facts: does not offer a native mobile app
items.gold_answer: No. Corvane Insight does not offer a native mobile app. The web application is responsive and supported on current mobile browsers.

items.question: Is the interface accessible for employees who use assistive technology, for example under WCAG?
items.gold_answer: Partial. The web application targets WCAG 2.1 AA. A third-party audit in 2026 found 4 open issues, which are scheduled for remediation.

items.question: Is generative AI built into the product, and can an administrator disable the AI assistant?
items.gold_answer: Yes. The optional AI assistant answers questions about dashboards. It is off by default, an administrator must enable it, and prompts are not retained by the model provider.

items.question: Is there a sandbox where our team can test configuration changes?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Enterprise customers receive 1 non-production sandbox workspace for testing, refreshed on request.

items.question: How much storage is included in each plan?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Workspaces on the Business plan include 500 GB of storage and Enterprise plans include 5 TB, with additional storage billed per TB.

items.question: Explain the pricing model and the plans available.
items.gold_answer: Yes. Corvane Insight is priced per named user per year, with 3 plans: Team, Business, and Enterprise. Volume discounts start at 100 users.

items.question: When are we invoiced and what are the payment terms?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Invoices are issued annually in advance and payment terms are net 30 days.

items.question: What cap applies to price increases when we renew?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Renewal price increases are capped at 5% per year for multi-year agreements.

items.question: Under what terms can we terminate the agreement early?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Either party may terminate for material breach with 30 days written notice if the breach is not cured, and prepaid fees are refunded pro rata when Corvane is in breach.

items.question: Can we try the software in a free trial first?
items.gold_answer: Yes. A 14 day free trial of the Business plan is available with sample data.

items.question: Do new employees and contractors go through background checks?
items.gold_answer: Yes. All employees and contractors pass a background check before they start, where local law allows.

items.question: How often does your workforce complete security awareness training?
items.gold_answer: Yes. All staff complete security awareness training at hire and every 12 months, engineers complete secure coding training every 12 months, and phishing simulations run monthly.

items.question: Are your employees bound by confidentiality agreements to keep our information private?
items.gold_answer: Yes. All employees and contractors sign confidentiality agreements before they receive system access.

items.question: What code review and testing does new software go through before release?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Every code change requires review and approval by a second engineer, and automated tests and static analysis must pass before merge.

items.question: How do you control and approve changes to the production environment?
items.gold_answer: Yes. Production changes go through a change management process with peer review, automated deployment, and a rollback plan. Emergency changes are reviewed within 2 business days.

items.question: Can we get a software bill of materials for the components in your product?
items.gold_answer: Yes. A software bill of materials is generated for every release in CycloneDX format and is available to Enterprise customers on request.
